prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 76-year-old grandmother receives a warm embrace from her 40-year-old adult granddaughter in a quiet family courtyard. Two adult relatives aged 35 and 70 wait nearby with simple flowers and a plain wrapped gift, their expressions affectionate and varied. Use unobtrusive framing, soft open shade, and modest ordinary surroundings without staged rows. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The grandmother has short white hair swept back, fine oval glasses, a long narrow face and clear natural wrinkles. Her 40-year-old adult granddaughter has a dark straight chin-length bob, a round face and no glasses. The background adult woman has short light-brown hair; the older male relative has a bald crown and no beard. Only four adult people, no children. Exact 16:9 wide environmental courtyard view. Keep the main embrace and all important faces and hands within central 55 percent of width, with open garden or courtyard margins.
review: Reviewed wide courtyard family image: white-haired grandmother with glasses embraced by dark-bob-haired adult granddaughter; another adult woman holds flowers and older bald man holds wrapped gift. Four distinct adults, coherent hands and embrace, main interaction safe in central crop, no lettering.
